resources.name: Excelsior API — Local and Production
resources.description: Current Card Database, Deck Builder, and Collection APIs. See INSOMNIA_API.md. Credentials and tokens are intentionally blank. Use a private Insomnia environment for credentials. Existing user identities and ownership apply. Service-client authentication will be added in Milestone 2; it is not available yet.

resources.name: 01 Health and app configuration
resources.description: Public reads; no authentication needed. HTTP API ports are separate from the PostgreSQL SSM tunnel.

resources.name: 02 Authentication
resources.description: Cookie login establishes a session for cookie-backed folders. Bearer login returns data.accessToken and data.refreshToken; copy these into a private environment. Refresh rotates both tokens. JWT logout revokes the supplied refresh token; existing access tokens remain valid until expiry.

resources.name: Guest cookie login
resources.description: Existing shared Guest login; guest decks are isolated by session.

resources.name: Bearer login
resources.description: Copy data.accessToken and data.refreshToken into private access_token and refresh_token variables.

resources.name: Bearer refresh
resources.description: Replace both saved tokens with the returned values after every refresh.

resources.name: 03 Card Database
resources.description: Public full-array catalogs. Filtering, sorting, printing grouping, and card-specific eligibility currently have browser consumers.

resources.name: Conditional characters (ETag)
resources.description: Copy ETag from an ordinary characters response into catalog_etag; unchanged catalog returns HTTP 304.

resources.name: 04 Owned decks — cookie
resources.description: Run Cookie login first as USER or ADMIN. Deck writes require ownership; Guest cannot mutate persistent decks. Validate uses type, while mutations use cardType. Invalid drafts can be saved according to existing save semantics.

resources.name: POST /api/v1/decks
resources.description: Creates a deck. Copy data.id into deck_id.

resources.name: POST /api/v1/decks/validate
resources.description: Does not save the draft. HTTP 400 DECK_VALIDATION_FAILED is a completed check that found an illegal deck.

resources.name: PUT /api/v1/decks/{{ deck_id }}
resources.description: Only send intended metadata updates. is_valid is server-owned.

resources.name: PUT /api/v1/decks/{{ deck_id }}/cards
resources.description: Replaces the entire deck card list.

resources.name: DELETE /api/v1/decks/{{ deck_id }}
resources.description: Deletes the named owned deck. Review deck_id and selected environment before sending.

resources.name: 05 Guest decks — cookie
resources.description: Run Guest cookie login first. These decks stay within this session and do not transfer after account sign-in. Guest collection is browser-local and has no saved collection API.

resources.name: POST /api/v1/guest/decks
resources.description: Copy data.metadata.id into guest_deck_id.

resources.name: 06 Collection — cookie
resources.description: Run Cookie login first as USER or ADMIN. Add missing owned printings with POST before changing quantity using PUT. Use image_path returned by the catalog.

resources.name: PUT /api/v1/collections/me/cards/{{ card_id }}
resources.description: Quantity 0 removes this owned printing; absent entries return 404.

resources.name: DELETE /api/v1/collections/me/cards/{{ card_id }}
resources.description: Deletes all printings for this card ID using the existing API behavior. Prefer quantity 0 for one printing.

resources.name: 07 Bearer access examples
resources.description: Run Bearer login and populate access_token. Cookies are disabled in this folder to prove direct HTTP token authentication. Same ownership rules apply as cookie paths.

resources.name: 08 Public discovery
resources.description: Public reads of community and official preconstructed decks.
